title: Settings
subline: {count, plural, one {{amount} playthrough} other {{amount} playthroughs}} stored in this browser · Preferences save automatically

storage.title: Data Storage!
storage.body: Your data is stored in the browser. It is lost when the browser data is cleared, unless you sync or back it up.
storage.action: Please use the functions below to export and backup your data.

manage.title: Playthroughs
manage.description: Rename, delete or create playthroughs on the Playthroughs page.

data.title: Data management
data.exportHint: Download a backup file of all your saved playthroughs.
data.importHint: Upload a previously exported file (.json). A confirm step asks whether to merge or replace.
data.resetWarning: Warning: This will delete all playthroughs and cannot be undone.
data.description: One backup file holds every playthrough.
data.resetSyncedCopy: Also delete the synced copy in {provider}
data.resetSyncedOn: Sync stays on. Your other devices lose these playthroughs at their next sync. Export a backup first if you are not sure.
data.resetSyncedOff: The synced copy stays where it is. Sync disconnects on this browser so it does not empty the cloud.

import.title: Import backup
import.description: Choose what happens to the playthroughs already on this device.
import.fileSummary: {inFile, plural, one {{inFileAmount} playthrough} other {{inFileAmount} playthroughs}} in file · {onDeviceAmount} on this device
import.mergeDescription: Adds playthroughs that are new. When a playthrough is in both places, the copy updated most recently wins. Playthroughs only on this device stay.
import.replaceDescription: Deletes the {onDevice, plural, one {{onDeviceAmount} playthrough} other {{onDeviceAmount} playthroughs}} on this device and loads the {inFileAmount} from the file. This cannot be undone.
import.confirmMerge: Merge {count, plural, one {{amount} playthrough} other {{amount} playthroughs}}

appearance.title: Appearance and preferences
appearance.defaultSortHint: Choose how playthroughs are sorted by default. Saves as soon as you change it.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Saved at once on this device.

about.summary: Track your Dinkum progress: fish, bugs, critters, milestones, licenses, NPCs and more. Everything is stored in this browser.
about.disclaimer: Not affiliated with or endorsed by the creators of Dinkum.

region.title: Language and region
region.description: Pick the language and how numbers and dates are written. Saved on this device.

language.label: Language
language.hint: Names of animals, items, NPCs and the other game data come from the game data and stay in English.
